**Chinese name:** 思特威（上海）电子科技股份有限公司 (Sītèwēi)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The clearest import-substitution winner in CIS: #1 globally in surveillance CIS, now cracking flagship smartphone cameras (Xiaomi/OPPO main and sub cameras) and scaling automotive CIS — FY2025 revenue ¥90.31亿 (+51.3%), of which smartphone ¥46.75亿 and automotive ¥11.22亿 (+113%); H1 2026 revenue ¥46.0亿. A March 2026 placement plan (up to ¥3.2 billion) funds vision-AI and edge-AI ASICs — an attempt to outgrow the sensor business.
:::

## What does this firm design?

1–50MP+ CMOS image sensors (security, smartphone, automotive, machine vision) plus emerging AI-vision/edge ASIC solutions.

| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | CMOS image sensors for security/AIoT, smartphone, automotive and machine vision |
| **Node Sophistication** | Specialty CIS platforms; 50MP flagship main-camera sensors (SC585XS family, LOFIC HDR 2.0) described by the company as a fully domesticated process flow; exact nm not disclosed |
| **Entity List** | No |
